content: Apple docs: EKRecurrenceRule.daysOfTheWeek valid only for weekly/monthly/yearly frequency; BYSETPOS (Apple: setPositions) only valid combined with daysOfTheWeek/daysOfTheMonth/weeksOfTheYear/monthsOfTheYear. mcp-ical's own README documents that non-standard/complex custom recurrence rules built through EKRecurrenceRule are unreliable in practice even when the API accepts them.
